title: Fed hikes 25 bp to 3.75–4.00%, its first hike in three years
summary: The FOMC raised rates unanimously. The Dollar Index gained about 2% in September and EUR/USD fell from ~1.1700 to ~1.1375 by 28 September.
ict: Macro to micro: rising rates attract capital, so the dollar’s higher-timeframe bias turns up. The September range built liquidity on both sides and the decision supplied the expansion. Trade the retracement into the new FVG or order block, not the release candle.
